title: Bug: Pebble xDrip+ watchface keeps alarming about low smartphone battery
symptom: The Pebble xDrip+ watchface keeps vibrating about low smartphone battery even though all battery alarms are turned off in xDrip+. The vibration occurs when the phone battery reaches 30% and repeats every 5-10 minutes, ignoring Pebble silence mode, and continues while charging until above 30%.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A developer (jstevensog) initially suspected a bug in the watch face where it tracks phone battery with the same flag as watch battery, but later retracted that statement, saying he was wrong about the bug.
fix: No resolution is provided. The original reporter stopped using Pebble years ago and could not provide further information. A developer suggested trying the latest nightly and the 'All platforms' watch face, and disabling vibrations in the Pebble app settings, but this was not confirmed as a fix.
evidence_quote: Also, I was wrong about the bug in the watch face. Serves me right to take a sneaky look during work.
